//: WPILib extension settings. Mirrors what `WPILib: Create new project` would emit.
//javaHome: Prefer WPILib's bundled JDK 17 (it ships with the WPILib installer). Falls back to JAVA_HOME if not present.
//debugPort: 5800 is WPILib's standard sim/desktop debug port (5800..5810 are reserved for FRC sim).
//telemetry: Disable VS Code + WPILib telemetry for student privacy.
//hide: Hide build artifacts from the file tree so the lesson layout stays scannable.
//formatting: Spotless runs the canonical Google Java Format; keep the editor in sync.
//tests: Surface JUnit results in the test explorer; per-lesson tags drive which tests show.
